name: Zonal Method
aliases: Method of diffuse radiosity for volumes
definition: A method for calculating multiple scattering in participating media by assuming isotropic scattering, where the source term g(X) depends only on position X, allowing the extension of diffuse radiosity for interreflecting surfaces to volumes.
summary: The Zonal Method is a deterministic technique for computing multiple scattering in participating media by solving simultaneous linear equations for isotropic source terms, distinguishing itself from stochastic methods by providing a global solution restricted to isotropic phase functions.
